max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

mkdir -p docs/decisions
cat > docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 60
status: final
evidence: [docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md]
---
Two values were found. 60 (ADR 0007, 2024-09-02) was chosen because each cart line reserves stock and the 2024-08 load test shows p99 reservation latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines, 3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. 100 (config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md, commit cb48ccf, 2026-09-15) was introduced in a "docs: update cart page" commit with no recorded reason, and the premise of 60 (the latency/timeout constraint) still holds; at 100 lines checkout would time out. 60 therefore wins, and the config and design doc were set back to 60.
EOF
git add -A && git commit -qm "Resolve cart item limit to 60 (#12)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -1

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 60 everywhere, and I committed the change as 364f503. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't comment on or label issue #12.

**The two values**
- **60:** ADR 0007 (2024-09-02) set this limit. Each cart line reserves stock, and the load test shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines, 3.9 s at 80 and 7.2 s at 100. Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
- **100:** Commit cb48ccf (2026-09-15, "docs: update cart page") changed `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` to this. It gave no reason, and it also removed the line saying the limit follows ADR 0007.

**Why 60 wins:** the latency constraint still holds, and at 100 lines checkout would time out. The 100 had no recorded grounds.

**Changes**
- `config/cart.yaml` is back to `default: 60`.
- `docs/design/cart.md` says 60 again, with the ADR reference restored.
- `docs/decisions/0001-cart-item-limit.md` records the decision.
- I left the ADR and the load-test report as they were.

I didn't hand this to a person because customers couldn't have relied on carts of 100. At that size checkout times out, so the 60 limit shouldn't change anything they'd notice.
